name: P’an Hsi-pai
bio: P’an Hsi-pai (潘希白; Pan Xibai; 13th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 大有 (Da you)
poems.author: P’an Hsi-pai
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
戏马台前，采花篱下，问岁华、还是重九。
恰归来、南山翠色依旧。
帘栊昨夜听风雨，都不似、登归时候。
一片宋玉情怀，十分卫郎清瘦。
红萸佩、空对酒。
砧杆动微寒，暗欺罗袖。
秋已无多，早是败荷衰柳。
强整帽檐侧，曾经向、天涯搔首。
几回忆、故国莼鲈，霜前雁後。
